ORAL ORDER 3 11-07-2024 None had appeared for O.P. No. 02 despite valid service of notice.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
3.

This application has been filed against the order dated 27.01.2020 passed by the A.C.J.M., XIV, in G.R. No. 5903 of 2018 (Rajeev Nagar P.S. Case No. 333 of 2018) by which the court below has taken cognizance for the offences under Section 498A, 34 of the IPC and Section  of D.P. Act.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioners and the O.P.
No. 02 had settled Patna High Court CR.
